subject: Copywriting
title: Rolls-Royce: The Ogilvy Standard
description: Learn Rolls-Royce: The Ogilvy Standard in one minute.

hook.text: 'At 60 mph, the loudest noise comes from the electric clock.' Ogilvy's Rolls-Royce headline set the gold standard.

buildup.text: David Ogilvy spent three weeks researching the car before writing.

discovery.text: The ad was 607 words of pure fact. Every sentence was a proof point. Ogilvy sold luxury through engineering specificity.

twist.text: A Rolls-Royce engineer reportedly said: 'We really must do something about that clock.' They missed the point—the ad.

climax.text: Ogilvy proved that luxury copy doesn't need poetry.

punchline.text: 607 factual words. 104 headlines tested. One clock made it legendary.

quiz.question: How many headlines did Ogilvy test for the Rolls-Royce ad?
